skill.name: detect objects
skill.description: Detect the blue bucket, pen, and bottle in order

source.summary:
The task (Grok's reading of the YOLO report):
No clear task was demonstrated. From 0.0 to 5.0 seconds the action is unknown: the person only began to say "I can..." and did not pick up or move anything. A blue bucket, a pen, and a bottle were present but were not handled.

YOLO report:
A person recorded a 5 s demonstration video of a task for the robot arm.
Objects in the scene: blue bucket, pen, bottle.
Actions, in order:
- 0.0-5.0s: described the task [unknown] blue bucket (other), pen (other), bottle (other) (said "‫אני יכול...")
What they said: "‫אני יכול..."
Write a skill that makes the robot arm reproduce this task: detect each object first, pick, place at the same destination, verify, then go home. Keep the same order. The arm's camera is on its head and it knows four objects: orange screw, blue bucket, green ring, white bucket lid; map what the person handled to the closest of these. Putting something in a cup/bucket/container means into the blue bucket; putting it to one side or on a pad means the delivery zone.

intent.goal: Detect each mentioned object without moving them
